title: China Scholarship Council-UCL Joint Research Scholarship
about: Joint UCL and China Scholarship Council scheme for prospective first-year PhD students who are citizens and permanent residents of the People's Republic of China, 2027/28 entry. Deadline 8 January 2027 for most subject areas; 13 January 2027 for Mathematical & Physical Sciences and IOE.
requirements: Citizen and permanent resident of the People's Republic of China at the time of application

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Prospective first-year PhD student" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"All research areas" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."

card_alt: Card for the China Scholarship Council-UCL Joint Research Scholarship at University College London (UCL), London, United Kingdom, deadline 8 Jan 2027. The photo shows Big Ben and Westminster Bridge in London.
